snippet.title: Tied To The Beat Then & Now | Early Access vs Version 1.0
snippet.description:
See how Tied To The Beat has evolved from Early Access to Version 1.0.

Improved maps, visual effects, gameplay and performance, alongside new content and a smoother experience.

Version 1.0 launches on October 9, 2026.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4316340/Tied_to_the_Beat/

#TiedToTheBeat #IndieGame #ThenAndNow
